_about: A model of the Apache Airflow runtime settings in two workspaces. settings_location is the section of the workspace settings, or the admin portal, where the default runtime is set. For each workspace choose the default pool, and describe a custom pool if one is needed (name, compute_node_size Small or Large, enable_autoscale, extra_nodes). Then set how the team's own package is added and record what you expect.
needs: In Ops-Dev, two engineers try out DAGs a few times a week. Nobody should pay for the environment while it sits idle.
In Ops-Prod, complex production DAGs run around the clock and must start without waiting. Month-end brings a spike of runs, and the team doesn't want to pay for extra nodes the rest of the month.
In both workspaces, the jobs import contoso_hooks, a wheel file the team builds. The jobs aren't connected to Git, so the wheel is uploaded with the job's files.
A newer Apache Airflow version will come out next year. The team wants to know how they'll move to it.
